question: After the two persistence-safety defects are fixed, should RFC 0016 continue with Claw-managed workspace files as an experimental OpenClaw core lifecycle?
rationale: The patch adds a new core package lifecycle, durable state model, and package-to-workspace trust boundary; code review can repair defects but cannot authorize that product and ownership direction.

options.title: Continue the core RFC slice
options.body: Approve the direction after canonical state ownership and orphan-file recovery are fixed and proven.

options.title: Pause the workspace lifecycle
options.body: Keep this stack unlanded while maintainers revisit lifecycle atomicity, cleanup behavior, or whether the capability belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Continue the core RFC slice
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after canonical state ownership and orphan-file recovery are fixed and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository history most directly connects this person to both the shared-state and root-scoped filesystem boundaries requiring an acceptance decision.
